topic.subject: science
topic.title: Light and the human eye
topic.scope: laws of reflection, regular and diffused reflection, multiple images, structure of eye, persistence of vision, care of eyes

misconceptions.statement: Objects become visible because our eyes send out rays to touch them.
misconceptions.why: Students often confuse the act of looking with an active process of 'reaching out' to objects.
misconceptions.fix: We see objects because light from a source reflects off the object and enters our eyes.

probe.question: Why can't you see a book in a completely dark room?
probe.wrong_answer: Because my eyes haven't looked at it yet.

misconceptions.statement: Light reflects off a mirror only when it hits at a specific angle.
misconceptions.why: Students often generalize from experiences with balls bouncing off walls where only certain angles seem to 'work'.
misconceptions.fix: Light reflects off a mirror at every angle; the angle of incidence is always equal to the angle of reflection.

probe.question: If you shine a laser at a mirror at a 30-degree angle, what happens?
probe.wrong_answer: The light just stops or gets absorbed because it's not the right angle.

misconceptions.statement: Rough surfaces do not reflect light at all.
misconceptions.why: Students confuse the lack of a clear image with the absence of reflection.
misconceptions.fix: Rough surfaces reflect light in many directions, which is called diffused reflection, allowing us to see objects from all sides.

probe.question: Why can't you see your face in a wooden table?
probe.wrong_answer: Because the table doesn't reflect any light.

concepts.name: Structure and Function of the Eye

misconceptions.statement: The pupil is a black solid spot on the surface of the eye.
misconceptions.why: The pupil looks like a black dot, and students lack the anatomical knowledge that it is an opening.
misconceptions.fix: The pupil is actually a hole in the center of the iris that allows light to enter the eye.

probe.question: What is the black circle in the middle of your eye made of?
probe.wrong_answer: It is a piece of black skin or a solid dot.
